physical_equations.law: (D_t-nu L5)Q=2m(p_r/r)/h-(2nu/h)(|grad m-m grad log h|^2+|grad b-b grad log h|^2)
physical_equations.full_diffusion: 3nu integral sqrt(Q)/h times the two squares + (4nu/3) integral |grad Q^(3/4)|^2 + axis_loss

classification.domain: h>0, b/h in an open interval I containing 0; all real m
classification.hypotheses: F is C2, convex, degree-one homogeneous, positive when (m,b)!=0, and exactly cancels (m^2-b^2,2mb,2mh)
classification.family: F=(m^2+b^2)/(h*g(b/h)), g>0 and g concave on I
classification.global_ratio_consequence: If I=R, positive concave g is constant; F is a positive multiple of the existing joint perspective.
classification.scope: Symbolic identities support the analytic classification, including its separate continuity argument at b=0.

diffusion.full_law: (D-nu L5)F=2mP/H-(2nu/H)(|grad m-m grad log H|^2+|grad b-b grad log H|^2)+nu*h*g_second(y)*(m^2+b^2)*|grad y|^2/H^2
diffusion.pressure: 2mP/H retains its sign for every admissible g
diffusion.conditional_consumer: R_g=int_R3 F^(3/2); retain full diffusion and the physical axis loss. The same all-prefix signed-pressure allowance gives the JP9 swirl L5 estimate with G replaced by g_max*G.
diffusion.bounded_example: g=2-y^2 on (-1,1), |b/h|<=1/2: Q/2<=F<=4Q/7; the extra diffusion term is nonpositive.
diffusion.limitation: H has additional production, so its mass is not the conserved mass of h.

pressure.origin: m=b=1, h=kappa, all first gradients vanish; P=296/715
pressure.domain_control: 0<b0/h0<=27/(exp(2)*kappa). Choose kappa once so this closed range lies in I; comparison of the common b,h equation retains it.
pressure.failed_assertion: A universal pointwise bound of 2mP/H by any finite multiple of the full chain-rule diffusion, for every smooth unforced datum.
pressure.not_refuted: An integrated allowance depending on the full original datum; nonlocal, history-dependent, nonhomogeneous or nonexactly-cancelling reserves.

nonconcave.failed_choice: g(y)=1+y^2 on R; reaction cancellation survives, convexity does not
nonconcave.conclusion: Diffusion contributes positive 6nu on genuine smooth initial data. This statement isolates that contribution and does not assert positive total defect at every viscosity.

integrated.quantifier: For every fixed admissible g and every nu>0, the actual datum u0=-A V with A>=100nu and sufficiently large original kappa gives increasing integrated stock on a short interval.
integrated.justification: The C2 coefficient limit is checked algebraically. Gaussian decay, pressure decay, dominated convergence and the local interval consequence are analytic.
integrated.limitation: Refutes automatic monotonicity for all permitted initial density normalizations. It does not exclude a specially selected datum-dependent normalization, a different g selected with it, or a positive full-datum allowance.

status: Analytic classification and PDE statements with exact symbolic fixtures; arbitrary-history pressure payment remains open. No new Lean certificate.
